decomposition.note: under A3-v1.1 MISSED ≡ timed-out (dip never arrived by cutoff), so missed_control_pnl is 0 unless a new state path appears; differential execution costs are inside gross_fill_gain (both arms priced at their own executable ask)

thesis_integrity_gap.interpretation: fills land disproportionately on windows that go on to lose — dips are partly informative repricing, not only overreaction

loss_mechanisms.mechanism: opportunity cost — winners that never offered the dip
fill-conditioned thesis degradation — adverse selection of the dip

prohibited_interpretation: do not infer an optimal threshold from the current sample; a smaller dip could reduce miss cost while worsening adverse-selection exposure — only the registered decision gate may adjudicate
